stories.headline: A Clue: The Duck Bandit Leaves a Thread — Copper-Green, Six Inches, Smelling Faintly of Pine Resin; the Investigation Has a Direction
body: The fourth duck — yellow, broad-brimmed hat, self-tightening Sticking Charm — was examined in full on Sunday morning. Three things were established. First, the hat is wool-felt, not mass-produced. Second, the Sticking Charm's signature is older than anything in current Ministry circulation, which Gringotts' own enchantment-dating desk, consulted informally, puts at pre-1980. Third, and most consequentially: a single thread, copper-green in colour, approximately six inches in length, was found caught on the Jeep's nearside mirror housing. It smells of pine resin. It does not match any fabric in the immediate household.

Steve has placed the thread in a small jar on the kitchen table. It sits between the sketch of the Room and the framed withdrawal of reference number 00-441-GF-7703-RMX-19, which remains there because Christine has not yet decided where else it should go. The duck, still hatted, is on the dashboard, facing forward.

What is known: the Bandit works at night, moves without footprints, favours millinery, and has access to charm-work that predates most living practitioners. What is not known: everything else. The investigation, formerly characterised by the total absence of evidence, has entered what Steve is calling 'a new phase.' The Jeep has not commented. The duck has not commented. The thread smells of pine.

stories.headline: Undersecretary Prentice-Hoole, Freed from Subcommittee Duties, Immediately Constitutes a New Body; Preliminary Terms of Reference Describe Its Purpose as 'Broadly Geographical'
body: Undersecretary Evander Prentice-Hoole, whose Subcommittee on Unmapped Geographical Features was formally dissolved Saturday following the application of Clause 7 of the 1847 Terrain Sovereignty Accord, has not — sources confirm — taken the weekend to reflect. By Sunday morning he had submitted the paperwork to constitute a Provisional Working Group on Terrain of Unresolved Categorisation, whose stated remit is described in its founding terms as 'broadly geographical, not jurisdictional, strictly advisory, and in no sense an attempt to re-examine any matter previously resolved under Clause 7.'

The Working Group has four members, three of whom were on the original Subcommittee. Tibbs is not among them. Cresswell is listed as Senior Field Liaison, a title that did not previously exist. The Room above Marker 9 is not named anywhere in the terms of reference, which legal observers note is itself a form of naming.

Christine has been informed. She has placed the Working Group's founding memo on the kitchen table, where it has joined a growing archive. The kitchen table has not yet run out of room, though Steve is monitoring the situation.

stories.headline: Sunday Vault Enquiries: Four Handled Before Noon; the Fifth Attempts to Lodge a Formal Grievance About Sundays; Christine Notes That Sundays Are Not a Vault
body: Sunday is, by Gringotts charter, a reduced-operations day. It is not, as one account-holder learned this morning, entirely closed, and it is certainly not open to procedural creativity. The fifth enquiry of the day — arriving by owl at eleven forty-three, from a witch who declined to give her account number — proposed that Sunday's reduced status entitled her to lodge a formal grievance about the concept of reduced Sundays, effectively creating a recursive scheduling problem that she believed entitled her to a Monday priority slot.

Christine untangled this in two sentences. Griphook the Younger, who had been watching from across the hall, was seen to make a small note on a piece of parchment and put it in his pocket. It is not known what the note said. He did not share it.

stories.headline: Steve Cross-References the Thread Against Every Fabric in the House; the Results Are Negative; He Expands the Search to the Shed; the Shed Has Opinions
body: Following the discovery of the copper-green thread, Steve conducted a systematic cross-reference against all fabric items accessible from the ground floor, the first floor, and the boot room. The thread matches nothing. He then proceeded to the shed, which contains, by his count, seventeen distinct textile items of uncertain provenance — canvas, burlap, one piece of what may be sailcloth — and which resists organisation in the way that only sheds and certain sections of Knockturn Alley truly do.

The shed did not yield a match. It did yield an old tarpaulin Steve had forgotten he owned, a spool of twine that is not copper-green but adjacent, and confirmation that the pine-resin smell is not from anything stored on the property. He returned to the kitchen table at half past twelve and wrote this up in the expedition log in his particular handwriting, which is legible but does not leave a large margin for ambiguity.
The thread is still in the jar. The jar is still on the table. The duck is still on the dashboard, hat forward, facing the road.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Was observed this morning sitting very still beside the kitchen table for approximately eleven minutes, looking at the thread in the jar with an expression described by one household witness as 'professional.' She has since moved to the garden and declined further comment.

Ellie: Became briefly convinced the thread was a worm, approached it with great warmth and good intentions, was gently redirected, and accepted this new information with characteristic grace. She now believes the jar contains a very small friend who is resting.
Jersey: Located the warmest available Sunday surface by nine-fifteen and has remained there without interruption. The investigation may proceed without him.
founding_editor_note: Copper-green on the nearside mirror — whoever did the placing knew exactly which side had the better angle. Craftsmanship. I'd have done the same. — D.

in_brief.sport: Sunday weightlifting log: complete; Griphook the Younger's single note, pocketed at eleven forty-six, is believed to say something complimentary; he will not confirm this.
in_brief.forecast: Pine resin on the air through evening; fog persisting in the lower hollows; probability of a fifth duck: rising.

storyline_updates.title: The Duck Bandit
storyline_updates.summary: Day 2: A copper-green thread, six inches, smelling of pine resin, was found on the Jeep's nearside mirror housing. The Sticking Charm on the fourth duck dates to pre-1980. Steve cross-referenced all household and shed fabrics — no match. The thread is in a jar on the kitchen table. Lucy was observed studying it with notable focus. Day 3 should deepen the pine-resin lead — perhaps a location associated with pine and old charm-work, or Lucy's interest proves meaningful. The hats remain a throughline; the next duck, if one appears, should have a more elaborate one. The Bandit's identity should remain unrevealed but the shape of them should grow slightly clearer.
